title: A Benchmark Study of Machine Learning Models for Online Fake News Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance across multiple datasets (Liar, Fake or Real News, and a diverse Combined Corpus) to evaluate whether models overfit to the specific dataset parameters and fail to generalize.

Applying topic modeling (LDA) to a diverse corpus and conducting a topic-wise analysis of misclassified (false positive) news to determine if fake news from specific domains (e.g., health and research vs. politics) is disproportionately misclassified.
